justification: Fixes a silent-wrong-data defect in the capacity engine's DCP setback handling, found by the gpt-5.6-sol cross-review tool. When a lot resolves to a specific lot-size band but that band's row lacks value_min (an extraction gap), _get_dcp_value borrows a conservative value from NON-applicable bands while _dcp_value_conflict suppressed the verification warning - so a cross-band setback figure was served as a single certain control with no gap note. The fix keeps the conservative (fail-safe, never over-reporting) number but surfaces the gap only when the resolved band actually supplied its value. Regulatory-value handling on a compliance product, hence standard tier; the change is narrow and pinned by a regression test.

pre_impl.existing_data: Traced the defect across _get_dcp_value (services/constraint_arithmetic.py:157) and _resolve_lot_band (line 137). _get_dcp_value line ~194 falls through to max(value_min across all matches) when the resolved band lacks its value. _dcp_value_conflict (line 220) is the only conflict/gap surface for setbacks (called for front/rear/side at the setback loop). No new data source; operates on an in-memory list[DCPControl].
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The prior code assumed 'a band resolved' implies 'that band supplied the value', so it suppressed the conflict. That assumption breaks when the applicable band's value_min is None and a cross-band conservative fallback is used - the served figure then comes from a non-applicable band.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new capability - a correctness fix to existing conflict detection. No DB queries added; behaviour only changes for the band-resolved-but-missing-value case (previously suppressed, now surfaced), verified to leave the clean-resolution and no-band cases unchanged (136 constraint+capacity tests pass).

functions.name: _dcp_value_conflict
functions.input: the DCPControl list, control_type, dev_type, and optional lot_area_m2
functions.output: the sorted distinct value_min values when _get_dcp_value had to choose (tiered/conflicting or cross-band fallback), else None
functions.if_none: returns None (no gap note) ONLY when a band resolved AND that band's value_min is present; a band that resolved but lacked value_min now surfaces the differing values instead of suppressing them

functions.name: _get_dcp_value
functions.input: controls, control_type, dev_type, prefer_max flag, optional lot_area_m2
functions.output: the applicable DCP value; the resolved band's value when present, else the conservative most-restrictive across matches
functions.if_none: unchanged by this PR - when the resolved band lacks the value it still returns the conservative max(value_min); the fix pairs that fallback with a now-visible gap note

values.if_missing: a resolved band whose value_min is None triggers the conservative cross-band fallback in _get_dcp_value AND (now) a surfaced conflict/gap note in _dcp_value_conflict, rather than a silent borrowed value

break_it.scenario: A lot resolves to one lot-size band, but that band's DCP row has value_min = None (extraction gap), while sibling bands carry differing values
break_it.what_happens: Previously: _get_dcp_value returned a value from a non-applicable band and _dcp_value_conflict returned None, so the user saw a single certain setback with no verification warning - a silent cross-band wrong value
break_it.how: _dcp_value_conflict now suppresses the gap note only when the resolved band's value_min is present; a resolved-but-missing-value band surfaces the differing values so the borrowed conservative figure is flagged. The number stays conservative (fail-safe, never over-reports capacity).
break_it.repro: tests/test_constraint_arithmetic.py::TestBandResolution::test_resolved_band_missing_value_surfaces_conflict - 600 m2 lot, <900 band value_min=None -> value 15.0 (conservative) AND conflict [6.5, 15.0] surfaced

post_merge.manual_verify: python -m pytest tests/test_constraint_arithmetic.py tests/test_capacity_golden.py tests/test_capacity_range.py tests/test_constraint_phased_ledger.py -> 136 passed. New regression test proven to fail on the old logic (old conflict result None vs new [6.5, 15.0]). Bug originally surfaced by scripts/cross_review.py (gpt-5.6-sol) on PR #725, then verified by hand against the source.
